proof_body:
by
  intro R n _ _ _ _ i j hij
  letI : LieRing (Matrix n n R) := LieRing.ofAssociativeRing
  have hji : j ≠ i := hij.symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have := congrFun (congrFun h i) i
    simp [Matrix.single, hji] at this
  · rw [LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, Matrix.single_mul_single_same, Matrix.single_mul_single_same, one_mul]
  · rw [LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, sub_mul, mul_sub, Matrix.single_mul_single_same, Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ hji _, Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ hji _, Matrix.single_mul_single_same]
    simp [two_smul]
  · rw [LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, sub_mul, mul_sub, Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ hij _, Matrix.single_mul_single_same, Matrix.single_mul_single_same, Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ hij _]
    simp [two_smul]
    abel
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (n : Type*) [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (i j : n), i ≠ j → (letI : LieRing (Matrix n n R) := LieRing.ofAssociativeRing; IsSl2Triple (Matrix.single i i (1 : R) - Matrix.single j j 1) (Matrix.single i j 1) (Matrix.single j i 1))
